facts.fact: 2019 年，怀孕的 Alice 从 Angel 地铁站出来赶回家，Gareth 要晚些才回
facts.anchor: Alice Wheatley came above ground at Angel

facts.fact: 她与 Gareth 现在的住处，部分是用当年卖掉利兹那套公寓的钱买的
facts.anchor: bought partly with the cash from the sale of the Leeds flat

facts.fact: 几小时之前她还不知道利兹那套旧公寓里是否还住着学生
facts.anchor: Until a few hours ago, Alice had had no idea whether students still lived there.

facts.fact: Alice 给 Matty 打电话，说自己今天收到一封奇怪的邮件
facts.anchor: there’s a reason I called. I received an odd email today.

facts.fact: 邮件来自住在 Otley Road 旧宅、住进 Emily 房间的学生 Olivia Kavanagh
facts.anchor: A student called Olivia Kavanagh who’s living in our Otley Road house. She’s got Emily’s room.

facts.fact: Alice 是看见玻璃杯压在 Emily 散落物品上面而不是下面的人，她曾把这事对外人提过一两次
facts.anchor: It was Alice who had seen the glass on top of, rather than beneath, Emily’s scattered possessions.

facts.fact: Matty 说她和 JJ 都不在乎 Emily，只有他一个人关心她
facts.anchor: You didn’t give a toss about her and nor did JJ. I was the only one who cared about her.

facts.fact: 电话被挂断后，Alice 想是否该删掉他的号码，他连她的孩子都没问
facts.anchor: She wondered if, finally, she should delete his number. He hadn’t even asked about her baby.
